name: complete-object-ui
title_zh: 新建对象后没人看得见？它把布局、列表、标签页补齐
tagline_zh: 刚建完对象，记录却打不开、列表里找不到、标签页没影——它逐个检查布局、列表视图、标签页，缺哪个就带你现写，连分区。
tagline_en: Records you can't open, lists you can't find, tabs that don't exist — it audits layout, list view and tab, then.
desc_en: Use after creating or extending an object, or when an object cannot be seen in the UI — checks whether it has a layout, list view and tab, offers to author the missing ones, and guides the sections, columns, sort and tab placement. An object with no layout has records that cannot be opened.
why_zh: 它先诊断再动手：没有布局的对象等于记录打不开，所以它把「看不见」拆成三件可验证的事，缺一件补一件。
why_en: Diagnose first, then build: an object with no layout means unopenable records, so it splits "invisible" into three checkable.
limit_zh: 只覆盖布局、列表视图、标签页这三样，字段类型、权限、校验规则、自动化流程一律不管；它只给配置方案和步骤。
limit_en: Covers only layout, list view and tab — not field types, permissions, validation or automation. It hands you the config plan and steps; you still.
title_en: New object invisible in the UI? It builds the missing.
